statement: For every priority control-plane partition, a non-failed standalone REMOVE is persisted only when strict services-owner evidence proves the exact source is a current active voter, voter count exceeds the policy target, and post-remove count and diversity are monotonic-safe. Unavailable or mismatched evidence defers, so leader handoff cannot turn stale superset rows into over-removal and MovieLens retains three spread control_plane_publications voters.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Fence only non-failed standalone REMOVE intents for priority control-plane partitions at canonical coordinator creation. Do not change planner precedence, target selection, ADD or REPLACE behavior, failed-replica cleanup, workflow dispatch/recovery, quorum floors, budgets, or membership-publication semantics.

Use the existing services-owner read with OWNER_RPC_REQUIRED and no SQL, cache, or follower fallback. Only a successful owner_rpc_lane observation with complete, non-conflicting replica identity may authorize deletion; unavailable, malformed, empty, duplicate, source-missing, or non-owner evidence must defer without persisting an operation.

Authoritative evidence must prove the named source is a current active voter, current active-voter count is strictly above the policy target, projected post-remove voter count remains at least target, and projected distinct-node count does not fall below the pre-remove distinct-node count. This is a compare-at-commit fence, not a second planner.

Perform no new authority read for non-priority entities, ADD, REPLACE, or failed-replica REMOVE. An applicable priority surplus REMOVE performs one finite services-owner observation and reuses existing policy resolution; add no timer, retry loop, cache, worker, or new eventual-consistency surface.

Before changing source, reproduce through createOperation the exact leadership-handoff order: canonical owner rows settle at r1/r4/r5 on three nodes while the new leader plans REMOVE r1 from a stale four-row local superset. Current source persists the remove; fixed source defers it. Also cover a genuine four-voter surplus removal, duplicate/malformed rows, owner unavailability, source absence, diversity loss, failed cleanup, non-priority, and no-read paths, with red-on-revert evidence.

After deterministic, focused, model, static, and independent proof, run the unchanged five-node formation probe once and at most one full MovieLens scenario on final bytes. Preserve any red evidence and do not rerun unchanged bytes.
